decisions.reason: The MMAK concept combines the firm's core shredders and screens into a modular system, and a quantified customer saving of over €600,000 per year shows the firm can read and use early market feedback.
The mobile slow-speed shredder sits at the heart of the firm's established knowledge base and has kept its own page across both years, so it stays easy to assimilate and improve.
This MMAK variant comes with a documented reference customer (Wiese Umwelt Service), which gives the firm interpretable results and learning from real use that strengthen the concept.
The 2024 slow-speed shredder line builds directly on long-held shredding expertise and holds a dedicated page, so the firm can develop it further with confidence.
The spiral shaft screens draw on the firm's screening know-how, likely replacing the dropped trommel screen, and their recent launch calls for more time to gather and absorb market results.
